body.x: AHN Materials Inc. (CEO Ahn Hoseon) participated in CES 2025, held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10 (local time), as part of the KOTRA Pavilion.

Founded in 2020, AHN Materials has been developing solutions to enhance the energy efficiency of eco-friendly mobility. The company was the first to introduce a triple-structure gaseous hydrogen storage cartridge, offering miniaturized, advanced solutions tailored to customer needs.
At CES 2025, AHN Materials showcased a portable liquid hydrogen storage container featuring a patented quadruple insulation structure and liquid nitrogen as a cooling medium.

Traditional liquid hydrogen storage tanks are typically large, suitable for use in plants or trailers, and require additional cooling systems, which limit portability and mobility. AHN Materials has overcome these limitations with its innovative technology, enabling compact and stable liquid hydrogen storage without additional cooling devices.

This technology utilizes liquid nitrogen as both a coolant and sacrificial layer. By leveraging the latent heat of vaporization from evaporating liquid nitrogen, the system minimizes heat transfer and achieves a daily nitrogen boil-off rate of just 8%.

body.cap: Alex Sigrist, AVING News reporter, interviewing AHN Materials representatives | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The storage container combines two double-vacuum chambers with dual coolant layers. Its design allows the chambers to be connected and secured via an upper cover, significantly improving the convenience of charging liquid nitrogen and liquid hydrogen.

With these technological advancements, the 5-liter model can store 354 grams of hydrogen, more than double that of similarly sized Type 4 gaseous hydrogen containers. Furthermore, it operates at a low pressure of 3 bar, offering enhanced safety during storage and transportation.

An AHN Materials representative stated, "Our innovative quadruple insulation technology enables the miniaturization of liquid hydrogen storage containers, expanding the usability of hydrogen energy and accelerating the development of next-generation energy sources. We gather feedback from potential global customers through CES to develop tailored solutions that meet their needs."

The representative added, "We aim to demonstrate the market potential of our technology to domestic and international investors, attract new investments, and identify strategic partners to collaborate with on our vision. Expanding our network on the global stage and exploring opportunities for international market entry will position us as a leading company in the hydrogen economy."

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
